groups.activity: check the research console before farming
conditions: The chain is strictly sequential. In a fresh Ghost-clan Bio Lab, it is a 15-day minimum before the Bubonico blueprint can be bought.
Research costs scale with dojo tier: Ghost x1, Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30 and Moon x100. Check your barracks tier before contributing.
Joining an established clan with the chain finished is usually far faster than building a solo dojo for one weapon.

disclosures.title: research is the real gate
disclosures.body: The weapon itself has no RNG. If the console says completed, this becomes a short materials farm and a one-day Foundry build; if it does not, the research timers dominate the plan.

conditions: Clan research unlocks the purchase; every player still buys their own blueprint.
Bubonico and its blueprint are untradeable. Coda Bubonico is a separate weapon and does not substitute here.
The first stage has the best listed chance; extract and restart after it when farming only Mutagen Mass.
Resource and drop-chance boosters do not affect bounty rewards.
bonuses: Infested Invasions can also award crafted Mutagen Mass when one is active.

disclosures.title: skip the single-use blueprint loop
disclosures.body: A Mutagen Mass is not a Mutagen Sample. Crafting ten Masses means ten single-use dojo blueprints, 150,000 credits and 100 Samples. The Vallis bounty can bypass that entire conversion.

conditions: Mutagen Samples are uncommon on Deimos but rare on Eris; farm Deimos rather than Eris.
Steel Path adds +100% resource drop chance. Stack a loot frame, Resourceful Retriever and a relay Resource Drop Chance Blessing if available.
bonuses: Hyf, Deimos Defense is a workable alternative if Survival pathing is frustrating.

conditions: Argon is stable through the next GMT 00:00 reset, then the decaying stack halves at each following reset. Farm it only after the rest of the recipe is ready.
Mastery Rank 13 is required to equip the completed weapon.
